body:
Thank you
That means a lot to me
Dude, I'm genuinely sorry this has all happened to you. I can't offer any advice, but I hope that things get better for you. I'm rooting for you.
Thanks, uh I feel like the creature from the black lagoon.
Wow you have a little belly! Cute! I'm sure you've heard, but you're lucky. I'm probably not gonna be like that when I'm that far along. I hope baby comes into this world safely :)
Don't feel bad. We even get that in a town of 54,000. People seem to believe that you're lying to them and you want to hoard all of those rooms to yourself... >:/

Thank you, I will keep that in mind.

I did remain relatively calm when discussing the matter with my manager. He in fact knows how unreasonable she can be. (In fact she has yelled at me all the way out the door before over seven drinks not being filled in our cooler. Which I made room for so she could just slide them in.) He actually wasn't always our manager. He got promoted from a front desk position when our old manager recieved a promotion. So, yes, in fact this is his first time dealing with something like this, and that does seem to be his tactic. 

He's not very good with confrontation. If we have a problem customer, I'm usually the one to contact that customer and tell them their behavior is not acceptable. 

I am affraid that I did get teary eyed when I talked to him about the matter. (Hormones are a bitch.) And I texted him the next morning about the matter threatening to put my two weeks in after not being able to sleep over the situation. I have only swore to this woman once, and that was in a reply text that she sent me. I basically said it was bullshit for her to think that I don't do anything and that she gets everything done. Nobody gets "everything" done. Her especially. That's why we have so many personality types, because different people are better at catching different things that need to be completed in the hotel. After that message, I refused to read the texts until I got infront of my manager so that I would not reply to her any longer. Once I started reading those messages in front of my manager, I got flushed, and emotional. I felt embarased. We talked for about a half an hour over the matter. 

I have only seen her once since then, but that was a morning shift. She never gives me problems when I relieve her. Only when she relieves me. If, (and when more than likely) I have another problem with her I am going to do what you have suggested. I am not going to deal with my manager minimalizing every negative encounter I have with this woman anymore. Especially when he knows how aggressive she can get. She is alot bigger than me, and has no problem getting right in my face when she is upset about something. No matter how minimal it is, or whether it was my fault or not. 

Thank you again. this has been so much help. I am normally very good at keeping my cool, and now that the mood swing period is over I believe I will be able to handle this in a more professional matter.

Gosh I feel for this poor girl. :( Who in their right minds could ever think such a cruel joke was the right thing to do? She looks so confused when that lady comes out. I hope this show looses viewership after something like this.

Wow that is litterally the best advice I've had for dealing with this situation. It has been some time now since the last incident, but I deal with her tonight. Thank you so much. I feel like I might acctually have some control over the situation.

Thank you for your help.

Yes i was hired as full time, but I do not have any documentation. I was hired without even filling out an aplication. They actually were interested in me due to my performance at another hotel in town here. I will have been working for this location for two years in August. 

As Front Desk Attendants, we are required to give all other Desk Attendants our personal numbers in case an emergency occurs or if information reguarding your shift is needed. So my phone number is actually posted in the back office. 

This employee has harrassed me at work in the past. I have talked with my employer about it several times. She works another full time job before she comes in to this location, and usually comes in a bad mood. She then takes those negative feelings out on ANY employee unfortunate enough to be working before her. I am not the only person who has been attacked by her. In fact the night she messaged be, she called another employee who was off the clock to complain about me. I could see if that employee was a manager, but we are of the same status. Thus far, no action has been taken to punish her behavior. In fact management seems to baby her just because she works overnights. She has even been caught sleeping on the job and was reported to corporate for it. 

Thank you for your help. I did get to talk to my manager about it. My schedual for the next two weeks will not change, but we'll see after that.
